# k3d Provider

Manages k3d clusters and the workloads that run on them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11"

  required_providers {
    k3d = {
      source = "bitbrew-dev/k3d"
    }
  }
}

provider "k3d" {
  docker_host = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `docker_host` (String) Docker endpoint, using `unix://`, `tcp://`, or `ssh://`. Falls back to the `DOCKER_HOST` environment variable, then the Docker client default.
